decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Due to its excessive residential density, the proposal would represent a cramped overdevelopment of the site, providing substandard accommodation and inadequate amenity space for future residents. The proposal is therefore contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and (H.4.2 Residential Density) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development, due to its siting and layout, would be out of character with the pattern of development in the area, and would result in enclosure, loss of outlook and privacy, harmful to the living conditions of neighbours to the south, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.1.1 (Location of New Housing Development) and H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 3 - Insufficient information has been submitted to determine the impact of the proposal on highway safety, and on the basis of the submitted plans, it is considered that the proposal fails to provide adequate vehicular access arrangements and would thereby likely to result in conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safe movement of pedestrians and vehicles in the area, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 and T.1.4 of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 4 - Informative: Should a further outline or full planning application for the residential development of this site be submitted, the Local Planning Authority would require a full Traffic Impact Assessment including a detailed analysis and design of the proposed access, in order to assess the impact of the proposal on traffic flow and highway safety.
description: Demolition of existing houses and erection of 64 flats (Outline application - Siting & Access)
